question_text: Which of the following figures does not belong to the same class as the others?

options.label: A
options.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><line x1='30' y1='80' x2='30' y2='20' stroke='black' stroke-width='6'/><path d='M 30 20 L 70 20 L 70 50 L 30 50 Z' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='4'/></svg>

options.label: B
options.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><line x1='20' y1='70' x2='80' y2='70' stroke='black' stroke-width='6'/><path d='M 80 70 L 80 30 L 50 30 L 50 70 Z' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='4'/></svg>

options.label: C
options.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><line x1='70' y1='20' x2='70' y2='80' stroke='black' stroke-width='6'/><path d='M 70 80 L 30 80 L 30 50 L 70 50 Z' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='4'/></svg>

options.label: D
options.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><line x1='20' y1='30' x2='80' y2='30' stroke='black' stroke-width='6'/><path d='M 80 30 L 80 70 L 50 70 L 50 30 Z' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='4'/></svg>

explanation: Options A, B, and C represent the exact same asymmetrical 'flag' shape rotated 90 degrees at a time. Option D is a mirrored reflection of the flag (the pennant hangs on the 'wrong' side of the pole relative to its base) and cannot be achieved by rotation alone.
